hypothesis: Official timestep-dependent flow-loss weighting improves clean val40 action loss by at least 0.25 percentage points beyond E24 while preserving positive video improvement.
single_variable: During training only, multiply per-video-row and per-action-token velocity MSE by the normalized bell-shaped scheduler training_weight used by LingBot-VA and DreamWAM. E24 architecture, ordinal time mapping, data, quantile normalization, seed, timesteps, optimizer and evaluation remain fixed.
parent_baseline: E24 quantile s100: initialization video/action 0.170026/1.304397; s100 0.166345/1.295573; action improvement 0.676%.

references.title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control

architecture.rationale: The H3 backbone port is fixed across parent and canary.

data.local: same first 800 rows and episode-disjoint val40 as E24

action.local: same E24 q01/q99, horizon32 and shift0.05
action.rationale: Carrier dimensionality differs but the seven active channels and schedule are equivalent and unchanged from E24.

objective.upstream_code: LingBot train.py and DreamWAM model.py multiply losses by scheduler.training_weight
objective.local: training-only per-row/per-token normalized scheduler weights; evaluation remains raw MSE
objective.rationale: The local analytic implementation matches both released scheduler formulas and is locked by unit tests.

optimization.upstream_code: FSDP with larger recommended global batch
optimization.local: 100 steps, global batch8, 800 unique windows, lr1e-6, warmup10, tail-2
optimization.rationale: A paired small-budget mechanism test precedes any scale-up.

evaluation.local: raw episode-disjoint val40 then no-leak sample40 and rollout only if threshold passes
evaluation.rationale: The offline gate bounds GPU and simulator cost without changing the metric versus E24.

evidence: fixed clean LingBot and DreamWAM commits; official LingBot repository rechecked 2026-08-13
same E24 model and ordinal chunk mapping
35 unit tests including analytic scheduler equivalence
evaluation bypasses weighting and reports raw MSE
weight mean is one; action shift0.05 weight range 0..3.84

decision.rationale: Do not launch s100 until real weighted-gradient and checkpoint-restore gates pass. If they pass, require action improvement versus initialization of at least 0.926% and positive video improvement before causal sampling.
